verses.english: Four Discourses on Not Directly Experiencing Form, Etc.

verses.pali: Atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then the wanderer Vacchagotta went up to the Buddha and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side, and said to the Buddha:

verses.pali: “ko nu kho, bho gotama, hetu, ko paccayo, yānimāni anekavihitāni diṭṭhigatāni loke uppajjanti—
verses.english: “What is the cause, worthy Gotama, what is the reason why these various misconceptions arise in the world? …”

verses.pali: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṁ maraṇāti vā”ti?
“Rūpe kho, vaccha, appaccakkhakammā, rūpasamudaye appaccakkhakammā, rūpanirodhe appaccakkhakammā, rūpanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya appaccakkhakammā …pe….
verses.english: “Vaccha, it is because of not directly experiencing form …
